text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Cafe!! Happy freaking birthday!! Which 
means, it's time to throw a party~!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you very much. Just hearing you 
say that is more than enough..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat, come on, don't be so cold! I've 
already got everything ready! It's your 
birthday, let's celebrate big time!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... having a big, flashy celebration is 
a bit much for me... I truly appreciate 
the thought, though...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Gah, come on! By 'going all out,' I just 
meant... I was getting into the vibe, or 
just talking big, y'know?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
There's a nice little spot on the back 
mountain. It's warm during the day, with a 
real pleasant breeze. How 'bout we go grab 
some tea up there?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I've got food ready, too! Cookies that'd 
go great with coffee, and stuff! Hey, what 
do ya say?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. If you insist, 
I'll gladly take you up on that...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Sweet, it's a deal! Let's head out then! I 
already called Tachyon too!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—Please wait. Could you reconsider after 
all...?
